source_evidence: Player exact 'Stop the cart and step out. Men, you really do not want to do this. In fact you should rethink your whole profession and join the military if theres no other employment you can find.' V steps to side of already halted coach, no aggressive attack or surrender. Fenar provides credible Help through visibly ready presence and short verbal corroboration, no Rage/Shift or resource use. Intimidation proficient +6 from v-skills.csv, attuned Luckstone +1. Before executed RNG declare DC19 withdrawal, DC14 pause/counteroffer, lower refusal. Actual visible Python secrets receipt f0ab37d0888f43813d5faa0f878a19bd d20 advantage5,8 take8+7=15: captain pauses and counters, not full withdrawal. Captain offers passage for two bales of wool instead of all demanded valuables; merchant protests, no authority to surrender his goods. Veteran's ordinary former-service history is newly established NPC self-knowledge, not secret sponsor. Approved 2014 Monster Manual exact four profiles verified previous user turn from 5etools-mirror-3/5etools-src GitHub bestiary-mm.json blob ea2a16def25116746411fa1de80c346444228759. G1: independent finite road gang with economic motive, no artificial main-plot connection; G2: meaningful talk, refusal, retreat/fight alternatives, no forced outcome; G3: fixed roster/positions/verified stats, predeclared opposed thresholds, no reward, no unearned surrender; partial result maintained. D321~10:31 Ossent frontier road, before combat. V instructs coach stop (already halted) and steps out alongside its south side at (0,-5,0), sword visibly floating as established, makes exact warning to gang. Fenar remains atop coach, visibly ready and verbally backs V in established third-person voice, meaningful Help. Genuine Intimidation advantage d20 5,8 +6 skill +1 Luckstone=15; predeclared DC19 withdrawal, DC14 pause/counteroffer; meets14, fails19. Captain reassesses, does not attack, offers to take only two bales of merchant's wool in exchange for letting both coaches pass, abandons demand for V's personal valuables conditionally but not robbery. Merchant objects to surrendering his own stock; no consent/payment/transfer. Veteran remarks he has previously served and does not want to return; new NPC-known self-history not any secret affiliation. Gang remains independent of frontier plot, no party secrets known; no surrender, employment promise or successful withdrawal. All seven positions/HP unchanged: C(60,0) Bandit Captain AC15 HP65, Vt(65,5) Veteran AC17 HP58, T1(55,8)/T2(55,-8) Thug AC11 HP32 each, S1(40,25)/S2(40,-25)/S3(70,25) Scout AC13 HP16 each, bow positions partial cover where blocked, road width20, east retreat open. Approved 2014 MM profiles verified directly via 5etools GitHub blob ea2a16def25116746411fa1de80c346444228759; no substitution or additional foes. Coach center(0,0), Mara driver front bench x5, Cirren inside, Fenar roof, horse team x10–20, wool wagon(-40,0) and merchant bench, horse team x-30–-20. No initiative, damage, attack, limited resource expenditure, surprise or new roll. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/merchant/horses healthy. LR0/6, provisions9/12 before D321 daily charge, purse3178gp4sp6cp. Encounter count2/5, consecutive2, no D321 random night check, D322 mandatory quiet. No changes to evidence, diplomatic credentials or commitments. V dice delegated until stop. Await V's response to reduced coercive demand or other action; eligible targeted failed DC19 Intimidation tier may be improved with player-authorized Knack per prior negotiation precedent, no expenditure yet.
